patterns.note: Asymmetrical, collage-like compositions with overlapping images and text blocks, breaking traditional grid structures.
A strong contrast between large, elegant serif display fonts for main titles and small, uppercase sans-serif for labels and body text.
A neutral, warm off-white background provides a clean canvas for vibrant product photography to introduce accent colors.
Key elements in the hero section, such as the main portrait and brand names, exhibit subtle parallax movement against the scroll.
Sections and individual content elements (like project images and text descriptions) are revealed with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport.
A unique horizontal scrolling timeline section presents projects chronologically, allowing users to navigate through years of work by swiping or dragging.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero image is subtly parallaxed against the scroll, creating depth.
Content sections employ a dynamic, collage-style layout where images and text blocks are positioned with intentional overlaps and varied scales, often breaking out of a strict vertical flow.
A horizontal scrolling mechanism is used for a timeline-based portfolio section, allowing a continuous flow of project cards.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body text) are paired with small, often uppercase, sans-serif body and label text, creating a sophisticated contrast.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its artistic, collage-like layout that eschews traditional grid rigidity, creating a dynamic and editorial presentation of work. The intentional overlapping of images and text, combined with a unique horizontal scrolling timeline, makes the portfolio feel less like a standard website and more like an interactive art book.
